verdicts.reason: A: the big serif headline is clearly the focal point and the logo is intact. But the bottle shrinks to a tiny thumbnail jammed into the top-right corner, and the right column (body copy, CTA, legal) is tightly packed. The legal text is nearly as large as the body copy, and the ribbon floats between the two columns. B: the headline is shrunk to about body-copy size, so the hierarchy collapses. The logo and bottle are tiny and crammed together in the left column. The CTA isn't aligned with the centred headline or the body copy, and a large empty area sits at the lower right with only the small legal line in it.
